name: Application Layer Protocol

control.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Recursive or Caching Resolver)
Architecture and Provisioning for Name/Address Resolution Service

evidence.rationale: Application-aware or restrictive outbound firewall rules can limit unauthorized HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, SMTP, and other application-layer communications used for command and control. A basic port-only policy provides limited protection when adversaries use permitted protocols.
Endpoint firewalls can restrict which application protocols and services may communicate externally. The mapping is partial because common application protocols may need to remain available.

This is a partial mapping because DNS is one of the application-layer protocols covered by this technique. Configuring trusted DNS servers affects DNS-based command and control but does not mitigate web, mail, file-transfer, or publish-subscribe protocols.
DNS filtering directly affects DNS and can also prevent connections to malicious domains used for web-based application-layer command and control.
Use network filtering between segments to permit only required application-layer protocols and authorized communications, limiting adversary use of application protocols for command and control.
Network intrusion prevention solutions can use signatures for known malicious application-layer traffic to block adversary command-and-control communications at monitored network boundaries.
Application-aware gateways can inspect and restrict unauthorized application-layer protocols, services, and destinations used for adversary command and control.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.

ATLAS results describe the ATLAS release in versions.atlas, pinned by commit and digest. ATLAS changes often: a later release can add techniques and mitigations. An empty mitigation list means that this release links no mitigation, not that no mitigation exists. agent_related is derived by this project from names.
